llm_state_before.updated_belief: Ru has highest atomic activity but is expensive; Fe is much cheaper and third in activity. steps.reason_for_choice: These three candidates dominate the decision risk per compute: Fe is the plausible low-cost industrial incumbent due to very low metal price; Ru is required because it has the highest atomic activity; Os cannot be screened by Fe because its activity exceeds Fe, and it is close to Ru in activity. Optimizing Ni/Co before knowing whether Fe is feasible has lower value because they are both lower activity and higher price than Fe and will be screened if Fe is feasible and cheapest.
